title: Strange fruits
text: There are many strange fruits in the world. Some have funny colors, some have strange shapes and some have a very bad smell!
The dragon fruit is pink on the outside. On the inside it is white with small black seeds. It comes from a cactus. It is sweet and it has a lot of water.

The durian is a big fruit from Asia. It has a hard skin with spikes. It has a very strong smell, like old socks. In some hotels and buses you cannot bring a durian! But many people say it is delicious.
The rambutan is a small red fruit with soft hairs. It looks like a little monster. Inside there is a white fruit. It is a bit like a grape.
Some fruits have funny names. There is a star fruit: if you cut it, every piece is a star. Do you want to try an exotic fruit? Look for one at the market!

grammar.title: Grammar: a, an and some
grammar.rule: Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound. Use some with plurals and with things you cannot count.
